chart.description: The number of incoming and outgoing bytes and messages
chart.name: I/O operations overview
chart.programText:
A = data('IncomingBytes', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true'), rollup='average').mean(by=['azure_resource_name', 'subscription_id']).publish(label='A')
B = data('OutgoingBytes', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true'), rollup='average').mean(by=['azure_resource_name', 'subscription_id']).publish(label='B')
C = data('IncomingMessages', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true'), rollup='sum').sum(by=['azure_resource_name', 'subscription_id']).publish(label='C')
D = data('OutgoingMessages', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true'), rollup='sum').sum(by=['azure_resource_name', 'subscription_id']).publish(label='D')
